title: Replimune overcomes ‘messy data’ to secure positive adcomm vote for melanoma therapy
snippet: The FDA’s Cellular, Tissue and Gene Therapies advisory committee voted 10 to 3 in favor of Replimune’s immunotherapy for advanced melanoma in combination with Bristol Myers Squibb’s Opdivo, but trial design was a major sticking point as the panel deliberated.

title: BMS’ ‘big beat’ clouded by Cobenfy, heart disease data delays
snippet: Strong quarterly results are prompting Bristol Myers Squibb to lift its 2026 outlook, though the company is facing another delay for key Cobenfy Alzheimer’s data and a pushed-back readout for milvexian.

title: Regeneron’s ‘aversion’ to M&A questioned as bumper Q2 builds war chest
snippet: Calls for Regeneron to step up dealmaking have intensified as the company has established an $18 billion cash pile and suffered clinical trial setbacks.

title: Daiichi’s pipeline falls behind rivals as cash flow nears peak: analysts
snippet: With Enhertu and Datroway hitting their peak revenue and rivals flowing into the antibody-drug conjugate space, Jefferies cuts expectations for Daiichi Sankyo.

title: J&J secures right to take the helm in up to $925M Sail CAR T pact
snippet: As part of the collaboration, Johnson & Johnson will have an exclusive option to acquire Sail Biomedicines for an additional $2.58 billion.

title: Sanofi’s new CEO wants more ‘realistic view’ of Phase 3 go/no-go decisions
snippet: Sanofi is going to "look very deeply" at its late-stage pipeline as part of a portfolio prioritization initiative, though new CEO Belén Garijo didn’t commit to shelving a specific number of assets.

title: Life after the lead asset: Advancing an early-stage pipeline
snippet: In this episode of Denatured presented by Arvinas, Jennifer Smith-Parker speaks to Arvinas President and CEO Randy Teel about the strategic discipline and leadership required to successfully refocus a company on an early-stage pipeline after a lead asset is outlicensed, discontinued or otherwise falls away.

title: New funding, new jobs: 4 biotechs hiring after series B raises
snippet: Biotechs that announced series B financing this year and are looking for employees as they grow include one that received over $100 million and another that has a partnership with a Big Pharma company.

title: Not-so-special delivery: When biopharmas fumble layoff news
snippet: So far in 2026, over 50 biopharmas have cut or plan to cut their workforces. If they didn’t take a careful, thoughtful approach to telling people they were being laid off, they likely left a negative impression on employees, based on stories shared with BioSpace.

title: Biogen validated the Alzheimer’s tau theory. CEO Viehbacher still isn’t betting the store
snippet: With so many unknowns, Biogen is carefully eyeing its next-gen Alzheimer’s treatment diranersen as a high-risk, high-reward project with the potential for a major payout around 2030.
